text:
Sam (CS Ops): FYI — we have ~12 onboarding customers in EU who saw provisioning delays and failed post-provisioning enablement emails this morning. Some have flagged renewal conversations.
Alex (CS Lead): Ugh. Which systems failed? Is this the same token-throttle incident from last week? :grimacing:
Levi (SRE): Not the throttle. Root cause appears to be the regional provisioning worker in eu-west-1 that stalled while processing large batch webhooks. We recovered the queue at 09:18 UTC. Most tenants retried successfully, but a subset hit timeouts & email send failures.
Priya (Solutions): Can we get a list of affected accounts and their renewal windows? I want to prioritize comms and book make-up enablement sessions.
Sam (CS Ops): I exported a list and attached to the ticket (CRM-4444). Affected: 12 accounts, 7 in trial, 5 in paid with renewals in <60 days.
Ruth (CSE): I already pinged the two high-touch customers who reported failures — they want an RCA and an expedited enablement slot. One asked about credits.
Alex (CS Lead): Agreed: offer targeted credits + priority enablement. Draft message for customers: "We experienced a provisioning delay affecting your onboarding. Root cause, mitigation, and next steps are below. We're offering a one-time account credit and a dedicated enablement session to get you back on track." Thoughts?
Priya (Solutions): Add specifics: timeframe, what we did to fix, what they might need to re-run (e.g., re-trigger webhook or re-upload CSV). Also include an opt-in link for immediate enablement slots.
Levi (SRE): RCA short form we can share: "At 08:54 UTC, the eu-west provisioning worker experienced a memory leak triggered by malformed bulk webhook payloads which caused queue processing to stall. We restarted the worker and patched input validation at 09:12 UTC; queue drained by 09:18 UTC. No data loss; some email sends timed out and will be retried."
Sam (CS Ops): I'm drafting the outbound now. Proposed subject: "Service update: Onboarding provisioning delay — immediate next steps". Draft below for feedback: 
---
Hi <CustomerName>,
We want to let you know about a provisioning delay that affected your onboarding earlier today (08:54–09:18 UTC). Our engineering team identified a stalled regional provisioning worker caused by malformed webhook payloads which prevented some post-provisioning emails and enablement invites from sending.
What we did: restarted the worker, patched input validation, and retried the queued sends.
What we’re offering: a one-time account credit equivalent to 2 days of dedicated onboarding support, plus a prioritized enablement session this week.
What you might need to do: if you were in the middle of a CSV ingest or webhook-driven deploy, please re-trigger the action; our enablement team can assist live.
Next steps: We’ll follow up with a brief RCA within 48 hours and a calendar link to pick a make-up session.
Sincerely,
Sam on behalf of Customer Success
---
Alex (CS Lead): Good. Make the first line explicit for high-touch accounts and add an apology sentence. Also include a link to the opt-in calendar and a support contact line.
Priya (Solutions): I'll create the calendar slots and share the link by EOD. Can CS Ops include a short checklist for re-triggering provisioning? A tiny snippet is helpful: 
```
- Re-upload CSV to /onboard/import
- Or re-send webhook with header X-Redwood-Retry: true
```
Ruth (CSE): I'll prepare a 30-min enablement agenda template and a one-click invite we can use for the 5 paid customers.
Levi (SRE): For the RCA doc: include timeline, root cause, scope (accounts affected), remediation, and permanent fix ETA (we aim to deploy stricter input validation + autoscale worker pool by 3/28).
Sam (CS Ops): Action items:
- Sam: send outbound to all 12 accounts within 2 hours (use segmented copy for trial vs paid).
- Priya: post calendar link to the draft and reserve slots.
- Ruth: prepare enablement agenda and assign CSEs.
- Levi: upload the 48-hr RCA draft to the ticket.
- Alex: approve credit amounts for the 5 paid accounts (suggest 10% invoice credit or one week of reduced seat fees).
Alex (CS Lead): Approve provisional credit policy: paid accounts get 10% invoice credit or one-week waived seat fees; trials get a free priority enablement session + waived setup fee. Sam, proceed.
ZendeskBot: Ticket CRM-4444 updated: outbound message queued; priority: high.
Sam (CS Ops): Sending now. I'll post the outbound copy here after send and track replies in the sheet. If any customer escalates to legal/sales, tag me + Alex immediately.
Priya (Solutions): Thanks team. I'll add a short customer feedback survey to the make-up session invite — we should capture whether this impacts renewal sentiment.
Ruth (CSE): Noted — will prep a quick CSAT+renewal-risk field in the invite to capture that.
Levi (SRE): Re: permanent fix ETA — I'll follow up in eng-runtime channel once we have a firm deploy window. Tentative: 3 business days.
Alex (CS Lead): Great. Keep me posted on any at-risk renewals. Sam, flag any accounts that ask for exec escalation.
Sam (CS Ops): Will do. Posting sent copy below and closing this thread after 1:1 follow-ups.
---
Sent outbound copy (final):
Hi <CustomerName>,
We sincerely apologize — earlier today (08:54–09:18 UTC) a provisioning process in our EU region stalled which prevented some onboarding emails and enablement invites from sending. Our engineers restarted the worker, patched input validation, and retried queued sends. No customer data was lost.
To make this right we’re offering: a one-time account credit (details in your portal) and priority access to an enablement session this week. If you were running an import or webhook, please re-run the action or reply and we’ll assist live.
We’ll share a short RCA within 48 hours and are taking steps to prevent recurrence.
Thanks for your patience,
Sam, Customer Success
---
Sam (CS Ops): any objections to sending follow-up RCA to the same thread after Levi uploads?
Alex (CS Lead): No objections. Good work moving fast. :thumbsup:
